{{Short description|French academic}}
[[File:Gérard Biau.jpg|thumb]]
'''Gérard Biau''' is a French professor whose contributions are specialized in [[statistics]] and [[machine learning]]. 

== Career ==
He studied at [[Mines Paris – PSL]] and obtained his PhD under the supervision of [[Alain Berlinet]] at [[University of Montpellier|Montpellier University]].

After getting his [[Habilitation to Supervise Research|accreditation to supervise research]] in 2003, he was appointed as full professor at [[University of Montpellier|Montpellier University]] in 2004. In 2007, he joined the Laboratoire de Probabilités, Statistique et Modélisation of [[Sorbonne University]]. Gérard Biau is a founding member of SCAI, the Sorbonne Center for Artificial Intelligence of [[Sorbonne University]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gérard Biau, director of SCAI, has been appointed to the Academy of Sciences |url=https://scai.sorbonne-universite.fr/public/news/view/85f85f25a49d0dd2af9a/3 |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=scai.sorbonne-universite.fr}}</ref> which he directed from 2019 to 2026.

He was a junior member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Les membres - Institut Universitaire de France |url=https://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/543-gerard-biau.html |access-date=2025-01-31 |website=www.iufrance.fr}}</ref> from 2012 to 2017, and served as the President of the [[French Statistical Society]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Gérard Biau, directeur de SCAI, élu à l'Académie des sciences |url=https://www.sorbonne-universite.fr/actualites/gerard-biau-directeur-de-scai-elu-lacademie-des-sciences |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=www.sorbonne-universite.fr}}</ref> from 2015 to 2018. In 2018, he was awarded the Michel-Monpetit Prize.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2018-07-14 |title=Laureates of the 2018 Thematical Prizes of the French Académie des Sciences {{!}} CNRS Mathématiques |url=https://www.insmi.cnrs.fr/en/cnrsinfo/laureates-2018-thematical-prizes-french-academie-des-sciences |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=www.insmi.cnrs.fr |language=en}}</ref> In 2024, he was appointed as a senior member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France]],<ref name=":2" /> and elected as a permanent member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-12-17 |title=Les sciences et technologies du numérique mises à l'honneur à l'Académie des Sciences {{!}} Inria |url=https://www.inria.fr/fr/les-sciences-et-technologies-du-numerique-mises-lhonneur-lacademie-des-sciences |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=www.inria.fr |language=fr}}</ref>

|issn=1533-7928 |access-date=2025-01-15}}</ref>  [[functional data analysis]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Biau |first1=G. |last2=Bunea |first2=F. |last3=Wegkamp |first3=M.H. |date=June 2005 He is one of the three authors of the teaching book ''Mathématiques et statistique pour les sciences de la nature'',<ref>{{cite book | last1=Biau | first1=Gérard | last2=Droniou | first2=Jérôme | last3=Herzlich | first3=Marc | title=Mathématiques et statistique pour les sciences de la nature: modéliser, comprendre et appliquer | publisher=EDP Sciences | publication-place=Les Ulis | date=2010 | isbn=978-2-7598-0481-8 | language=fr }}</ref> and co-author, with [[Luc Devroye]], of the monograph ''Lectures on the Nearest Neighbor Method''.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Biau |first1=Gérard |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-319-25388-6 |title=Lectures on the Nearest Neighbor Method |last2=Devroye |first2=Luc |date=2015 |publisher=Springer International Publishing |isbn=978-3-319-25386-2 |series=Springer Series in the Data Sciences |doi=10.1007/978-3-319-25388-6 |access-date=2025-01-15}}</ref>

Gérard Biau is an associate editor of the statistical journals [[International Statistical Institute|''International Statistical Review'']] (since 2009),<ref>{{Cite web |title=onlinelibrary.com |url=https://onlinelibrary.com/page/journal/17515823/homepage/editorialboard.html |access-date=2025-01-31 |website=onlinelibrary.com}}</ref>  ''[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]]'' (2017-2025),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Learn about Journal of the American Statistical Association |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/uasa20/about-this-journal#editorial-board |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=Taylor & Francis |language=en}}</ref> ''[[Biometrika]]'' (since 2018),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Editorial_Board |url=https://academic.oup.com/biomet/pages/Editorial_Board |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=Oxford Academic |language=en}}</ref> and ''[[Annals of Statistics|The Annals of Statistics]]'' (since 2019).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Annals of Statistics |url=https://imstat.org/journals-and-publications/annals-of-statistics/ |access-date=2025-01-15 |language=en}}</ref>
